_about: The ONE place the character lives for payroll_app. The brain (backend/persona.py) and the page (frontend/src/persona.ts) both read this file; prompts, greetings, UI copy, alt text and tests take the name, voice and languages from here. To change the character, edit this file (an avatar character and a voice that speaks every language listed; see the catalog at /api/v1/catalog.get).
